description: Closure Library project builds through command-line features: --js globs expanded by the compiler itself (with ! exclusions; directory order is the file system's), a --flagfile with a BOM, quotes and escapes, goog.getMsg translations from XTB files (with and without --translations_project, ASCII-escaped and UTF-8 output), --hide_warnings_for, --error_format=JSON, a warnings allowlist and conformance rules.
